jmapcDoc: Agenda lists what is happening in a window of time, expanding recurring events so that each occurrence comes back as its own entry.

methodCalls.jmapcComment: Without expandRecurrences a weekly meeting is one event; with it, one entry per occurrence, which is what a day view needs.
reduceParticipants keeps a meeting with two hundred people from returning two hundred participants, of which a list view needs none but the organiser and the user.
